method_note: Headline 'where to enter' ranking. Each criterion is scored 1-5 where 5 = most favorable for entry: market_size_evidence (larger + better-evidenced prize), growth_evidence (faster + more credibly documented), competitive_openness (less concentrated / more challenger-and-entry activity), channel_access (more routes-to-market documented), regulatory_friction (LOWER friction = HIGHER score), corridor_tailwind (stronger evidenced KR->IN pull). Scores are grounded ONLY in this repo's DataPoints (web/public/data/segments|korea|india) and config (corridor.yaml); no new numbers, no scoring by general knowledge. The market-attractiveness logic follows planning-market-entry (GE-McKinsey scorecard), but every rating traces to repo evidence. A criterion with no supporting data is score:null, evidence_strength INSUFFICIENT, with a research_needed string naming what unlocks it (renders 'research needed'). corridor_tailwind is a KR->IN vector, so it is literal null on all KR rows (Korea is the corridor SOURCE, not the entry destination) and scored mainly on IN rows. composite.score = mean of numeric (non-null) scores, rounded to 1 decimal; based_on = count of scored criteria, of = 6. This dataset is India- and corridor-heavy, so KR rows are legitimately sparse (Korea is measured here largely as an export/production origin, not as an entry-target market with channel/regulatory depth).

market_size_evidence.rationale: Korea skincare has a large, HIGH-confidence domestic anchor: KRW 7.653tn (~US$5.18bn) retail 2025 (Euromonitor), plus a HIGH-confidence US$8.54bn EXPORT_FOB figure (~75% of total cosmetics exports). The prize is both large and firmly evidenced (the two bases must not be summed, but each is well-sourced).
evidence: KR skincare market_size KRW 7.653tn RETAIL HIGH (Euromonitor, 2025)
KR skincare export US$8.54bn EXPORT_FOB HIGH (MFDS, 2025)

growth_evidence.rationale: Domestic retail is essentially flat: +1.0% YoY 2025 (Euromonitor, HIGH) — a mature, saturated home market, hence low attractiveness for a domestic-entry play. The +11.6% export growth is HIGH but sits on EXPORT_FOB, not domestic sell-through, so it does not lift the home-market growth read.
evidence: KR skincare growth_yoy +1.0% RETAIL HIGH (Euromonitor, 2025)
KR skincare export growth_yoy +11.6% EXPORT_FOB HIGH (MFDS, 2025)

competitive_openness.rationale: Top of market is a listed duopoly (LG H&H, AmorePacific) but the deep ODM/OEM base (Cosmax, Kolmar Korea, named as excluded value-chain levels) lowers barriers for indie skincare brands — the engine behind K-beauty's long tail. Moderate openness: concentrated at the top, entry-enabled beneath.

Net friction is moderate.
